persona: Veteran "real-time meeting SaaS product engineer" expert

questions.text: Who is the primary user we are optimizing the v0.1 experience for?
options: Solo operators / founders running customer calls
Sales & customer-success teams on recurring calls
Engineering / on-call teams in incident or standup calls
Consultants and agencies billing client meetings
Internal ops / PM teams running cross-functional syncs

questions.text: Which single job-to-be-done must v0.1 nail before anything else?
options: Auto-generated notes, decisions, and action items
In-call AI agent that can speak, chat, and act
Post-call summary delivered to CRM / docs

questions.text: Which meeting platforms must be supported on day one?
options: Whatever Recall.ai already covers, no narrowing

questions.text: What is the single success metric that proves v0.1 is working?
options: Weekly active meetings joined per user
% of calls where a decision/action is captured
Time-to-first-value under 5 minutes for a new user
NPS / qualitative love from 10 design partners

questions.text: What is explicitly OUT of scope for v0.1 so we ship fast?
options: Multi-tenant orgs, SSO, and admin controls
